_readme: Fleet events: the orchestrated shows (docs/characters/FLEET-EVENTS.md). Each is a conductor scene hosted on
this node's selected character (Orlok). run-next.mjs rotates through `events` in order, one per invocation,
and is fired by the managed crontab every half hour in show hours (see README.md).
quietHours: the runner refuses to start a show between start and end (local time, America/Chicago on every Pi).
busyRetry: when any node reports a live guest conversation, wait delayMs and look again, up to attempts times.
playTimeoutMs: how long one conductor may run before the runner gives up on it and releases every node.

An event with "node" is that node's scene (its own scene id), played through that node's scene API; the Slipknot and Nosferatu conductors are Groundbreaker's (operator 2026-10-18: both shows run from Alpha's scheduled events).
